name: Tokyo
notes: Primary Golden Route anchor; also common arrival/departure point.

name: Kyoto
notes: No airport; reached by shinkansen. Has its own accommodation tax schedule (see taxes.json).

name: Osaka
notes: Common Kansai gateway; frequently used as a cheaper base for Kyoto day trips.

name: Hakone
notes: Onsen town, common 1-2 night side trip from Tokyo.

name: Nara
notes: Usually a day trip from Kyoto or Osaka rather than an overnight base.

name: Hiroshima
notes: Reached via Sanyo Shinkansen; gateway to Miyajima.

name: Kanazawa
notes: Reached via Hokuriku Shinkansen from Tokyo.

name: Takayama
notes: Reached via limited express from Nagoya; no shinkansen access.
